title: pipeline.v1
description: pipeline.toml, the ONE declaration of a consumer's stages, what each reads and writes, its network class, and the typed data files. The run card, the store and the Bash hook all derive from it.

consumer.description: The consumer's world-visible names. The harness hard-codes none of them.

approval_key_fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the approval signing key (ssh-keygen -l); must match the allowed_signers file.

site_hosts.description: Host substrings a direct HTTP client must never reach.

site_overlay.description: true: the site specifics (default_site, default_region, site_hosts, [plugins] sources, python_path and schema_dirs (paths resolved against the site file's folder and added to the repo's), [crawl] proxy and refresh) come from a site file outside the repo, $<env_prefix>_SITE_CONFIG else $<data_env>/config/site.toml, under [pipeline.*]; unreadable = refuse (pipeline.py OVERLAY_ALLOWED).

stages.description: Ordered: a stage's position is its 'Stage N/M' on the run card.

utilities.description: Commands outside the stage order (card shows 'utility').

plugins.description: The consumer's own code and schemas, paths relative to pipeline.toml.

commands.description: 'module:function' entries; each function(subparsers) adds the consumer's own subcommands.

additionalProperties.description: A plug-in group (sources, drivers, extractors, geocoders, ...): name -> 'module:Class'.

claude.description: The consumer's own Claude Code permission rules, merged into the generated .claude/settings.json.

block_extensions.description: File extensions the browser never fetches (images, fonts, media). Each becomes an anchored CDP URLPattern *://*:*/*.<ext>, matched on the PATH's end, so a page, a CSS or a JS file is never hit by a substring. [] blocks nothing. Absent: the operator-approved images, fonts and media (browser.BLOCK_DEFAULT).

image_mode.description: How the browser keeps the image extensions of block_extensions off the network: answer (default) serves a local placeholder SVG, so a page sees a loaded image (no onerror retries, no collapsed layout); block refuses them (onerror fires). Fonts and media are blocked either way.

image_placeholder.description: The answer placeholder's [width, height] in px (default [300, 200]).

proxy.description: The run's proxy: ONE per run, for the browser, the HTTP client and the egress preflight. HTTP only (Chromium refuses authenticated SOCKS5). `url`, or `urls` with a `choice` that a new run's --plan uses to pick one (random | round_robin); the plan signs the chosen URL, and a resumed run keeps its own. Credentials are Keychain item NAMES, read through the secret CLI's exec path at launch.

refresh.description: `<cli> refresh`: the ONE on-demand chain, run by doit in this order under ONE single-use bounded Touch ID approval. Nested under [crawl], not a top-level [refresh], so a pinned plugin that knows pipeline.v1's top-level keys keeps working. Step names are existing commands (stages or utilities), each once except crawl-lists (one step per list set, e.g. per subcategory; each set is signed and crawled once); a site step must be crawl-lists or fetch-ads (the steps that take --refresh-run); a paid step declares paid_gate or paid_exempt (checked on load).

groups.description: Named entry lists, referenced from inputs/outputs as '@name'.

plan_outputs.description: What every --plan invocation writes instead of the command's outputs.

files.description: Typed JSONL files under DATA: kind -> path + record schema.

offline_flags.description: Flags that make a network-class command offline (the hook allows it). A space matches ' ' or '='.

entry.description: 'ROOT:template' (ROOT is DATA, STATE, OLD or stdout; {name} is filled from the run's real context), or '@group'.

network.description: none: offline. site: requests to the crawled site. paid: a metered API. The hook blocks site/paid unless an offline flag is present.

args.description: Arguments the task runner (`<cli> run`) passes to this stage, e.g. its subcategory.

operator_only.description: Only the operator runs it (the hook asks, never allows silently).

secrets_env.description: The env var NAMES this command needs to run (e.g. a paid API key or a database DSN). `<cli> preflight` and `<cli> refresh` check each one is set and non-empty, by name only, before any approval; a value is never read out or printed.

args.description: The step's own arguments. Never --approve-network, --refresh-run, --plan or --dry-run: the runner adds what a step needs.

paid_gate.description: A paid step first runs its own --dry-run, reads count_field from its JSON stdout, and stops (exit 3, resumable) unless the count is 0 or the operator passed `<cli> refresh --<step>-count N` equal to it; it then runs with --max-requests N when the step has that option.

paid_exempt.description: Why this paid step needs no count gate, in the consumer's own words next to the step.
